articles.title: Treasury yields moderate as investors parse retail sales data
articles.summary: Treasury yields gave up their gains Tuesday as investors digested key economic data from the federal government and comments from Federal Reserve officials. The benchmark 10-year Treasury yield rose nearly 1 basis point to 5.129%, while the long-dated 30-year Treasury bond was trading relatively flat at 5.471%.

articles.title: Nike lays out financial goals ahead of first investor day in 9 years
articles.summary: Nike said Tuesday ahead of its first investor day in nine years that it was reaffirming its 2027 financial guidance. The retailer also laid out a financial framework and said that by the end of fiscal 2031 it's targeting approximately $5 billion in incremental revenue growth from fiscal year 2027, operating margins of 12% to 14% and adjusted earnings per share of $3.00 to $3.50.

articles.title: Deutsche Bank shares sink as whistleblowers reveal Epstein payments, Trump tax leak, Russia bets
articles.summary: Deutsche Bank shares fell sharply in early trading on Tuesday after whistleblowers leaked about 15 million files from the German lender, with media reports revealing alleged historic failures across its risk management and financial crime controls. Shares in Deutsche Bank were 4.7% lower by 9:20 a.m. Deutsche Bank processed $582 million in suspicious payments linked to Jeffrey Epstein, far more than previously known, the FT reported.

articles.title: Demis Hassabis’ AI company raises $5 billion, months after he left as Google DeepMind CEO
articles.summary: Isomorphic Labs, an artificial intelligence drug discovery startup founded by former Google DeepMind chief Demis Hassabis, has raised a $5 billion Series C, the company said on Tuesday. Isomorphic's round comes three-and-a-half months after Hassabis stepped back as CEO of DeepMind, Google's AI lab, which he co-founded before the Big Tech giant acquired it in 2014.

articles.title: St. Louis Fed's Musalem says four more rate hikes may be needed in coming months
articles.summary: Louis Federal Reserve President Alberto Musalem indicated Tuesday that the central bank may need as many as four rate hikes in coming months, offering one of the most hawkish views yet by a Fed policymaker about the steps needed to quell inflation. "The economy will likely require several interest rate increases before the spring of 2027 to achieve 2% inflation in a timely manner," he said.

articles.summary: With Anthropic set to make its public market debut this week at a reported valuation of $1.4 trillion, the market's reception to the deal and early trading in its shares may set the tone for the next leg in the private market AI boom. articles.title: Nvidia has lost $2 trillion in value. Here's what options traders expect from earnings
articles.summary: Jensen Huang's forced exit from Nvidia shocked Wall Street and Washington, wiped $2 trillion off its market value, and raised serious questions about national security and regulation of the AI complex. With volatility in the stock near the highest since April 2025, options traders are now pricing a 7% reaction in the stock after its report, the biggest implied move going into an Nvidia report since February 2025, and well above the median move of 3.2% over the last eight quarters.

articles.title: Investors look to Nvidia's earnings and Anthropic's IPO to refresh the tech rally
articles.summary: There is still room and time for the market to prove that the messy sell-down in AI-reliant growth stocks is simply a painful adjustment phase and the S&P 500's six-month purgatorial range a mid-cycle refresh. Perhaps Nvidia's results on Tuesday clearing the way for the company to restart stock buybacks and the final allocation of Anthropic's IPO shares will refresh the tech bid.

articles.title: Bitcoin slides to $62,000 following liquidation cascade, then rebounds slightly
articles.summary: Bitcoin fell to its lowest levels since August over the weekend as a wave of forced liquidations accelerated amid broader weakening in market liquidity and risk appetite. On Friday, the dollar index — which has an inverse relationship with bitcoin — reached its highest level since April 2025, following hotter-than-expected inflation earlier this week that increased expectations of further Fed tightening.

articles.title: Robert Pattinson cast as next James Bond
articles.summary: Robert Pattinson has been cast as the next James Bond in the upcoming film from director Denis Villeneuve. It will be the 26th James Bond film and the first since Amazon MGM took over the iconic franchise. "James Bond is one of the most legendary characters in cinema, and to be entrusted with 007 is the honour of a lifetime," Pattinson said in a statement.

articles.title: Nvidia fallout: Commerce targets loophole for China's data center use
articles.summary: The Commerce Department on Monday moved to close a loophole that has let Chinese companies lease Nvidia's advanced computing power from data centers in third countries, effectively circumventing controls on sensitive chip technology being exported to China. Share prices of Nvidia and other companies linked to the artificial intelligence trade fell Monday morning after the interim rule was announced, among them chipmakers Micron Technology, Intel and Advanced Micro Devices.
